About ResearchGate
ResearchGate is where science happens online. Over 26 million researchers globally use our platform to discover groundbreaking research, connect with peers, and advance their work.
What we do matters. By providing the world’s leading pharma, biotech, and scientific organizations with precision digital advertising and content solutions, we connect them directly with the global scientific community.

The partnerships you build will bring vital tools, clinical data, and breakthrough technologies directly to the minds actively solving humanity's most complex medical and scientific challenges. Your work doesn't just drive revenue—it directly accelerates the discoveries that change the course of human history.

We are looking for a high-performing Senior Sales Manager to join our Marketing Solutions department, owning and growing a portfolio of enterprise life science accounts. You will drive full-cycle sales—from strategic outbound prospecting to close— selling high-value digital advertising solutions and custom media campaigns directly to life science marketers and their media agencies.
This is a consultative, multi-stakeholder digital media sale with true deal ownership and a clear sense of purpose. You won't just pitch and pass; you will architect partnerships that connect pioneering life science brands with the global scientific community.

Reporting to the VP of Sales, you will join a high-performing, international, and collaborative commercial team focused on connecting researchers with tools and solutions that accelerate scientific progress.

Drive Ad Revenue: Close net-new and expansion digital advertising business across a dedicated portfolio of pharma, biotech, and scientific brands.
Consultative Media Selling: Run structured, deeply analytical discovery sessions to understand brand objectives and build tailored, insight-led digital media and content strategy proposals .
Navigate Marketer Ecosystems: Confidently pitch to and steer deals through complex brand teams, digital marketing leads, agency partners , and procurement.
Strategic Account Planning: Build and execute long-term account roadmaps to scale our share of wallet and maximize ad spend within key organizations.
Collaborate for Campaign Success: Partner closely with Account Management and Ad Ops to ensure ad campaigns perform flawlessly against client KPIs , securing renewals and long-term retention.
What Success Looks Like
Consistently hitting and exceeding your quarterly advertising revenue quota.
Growing key enterprise accounts year-over-year through strategic digital media upselling.
Delivering high-ROI ad campaigns that naturally convert into predictable, repeat business.

The Track Record : 5+ years of closing experience in B2B digital advertising, ad-tech, digital media sales, or publisher solutions.
Marketer Fluency : Deep understanding of digital advertising metrics (CPM, CTR, lead generation, brand awareness) and how life science marketers allocate budgets.
Industry Context: Experience selling into pharma, biotech, or life sciences—or managing these verticals from an ad agency perspective—is a strong plus.
Pipeline Ownership : A proactive hunter mindset. You are comfortable prospecting, mapping out marketing departments, and building your own pipeline without relying on inbound leads.
Commercial Polish : Strong commercial instinct. You know how to qualify rigorously, multi-thread within complex marketing organizations, and close high-value ad contracts

A Legacy-Defining Mission: Align your sales career with a monumental purpose. Every deal you close helps get vital information and technology into the hands of the pioneers solving the world’s most critical health crises.
Unmatched Digital Reach: Tap into a unique, highly coveted global audience of 26M+ verified researchers that marketers cannot find anywhere else.
Proven Impact: Sell premium first-party ad inventory and native solutions with undeniable product-market fit.
An International, High-Performing Culture: Work alongside a diverse, driven team scaling a world-class platform.
Work Style & Flexibility
We operate with a Digital-First philosophy, meaning our processes and communication are built for flexibility. However, we believe in the power of face-to-face collaboration to build strong team culture:
Berlin Hub: Our team comes together in our vibrant Berlin office 3 days a week .
Work from Abroad : Enjoy the ultimate flexibility with up to 120 days per year of working remotely from abroad.
ResearchGate is an equal opportunity employer
We encourage people from all backgrounds and life experiences to apply with us and help us change the world of science. We commit to impartial and inclusive hiring processes, and therefore ask you to please refrain from adding a picture and your age to your application form or CV.

Our hiring decisions are made based on your skills and qualifications, regardless of your age, gender, origin or race/ethnicity, nationality, sexual orientation, disability status, religion, or any other (perceived) personal characteristics. We are excited to receive your application.

ResearchGate is the largest professional network for scientists and researchers. Over 26 million members from 193+ countries use ResearchGate to share, discover, and discuss research

Über uns
Bei VREY bauen wir das EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser .
In Deutschland stehen über 3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser – und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende. <1% Solardurchdringung. <2% Smart Metering. Kaum Flexibilität oder intelligentes Energiemanagement.
Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. Das Mehrfamilienhaus wird vom Betongold zum aktiven Teil der dezentralen Energieinfrastruktur.
Was fehlt, ist ein integriertes System, das diesen Wandel wirtschaftlich und operativ beherrschbar macht.
VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (§42b EnWG).
Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance:
Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer,
~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und
digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität.
Bereits heute betreuen wir eine dreistellige Anzahl an Projekten - darunter die größten Bestandshalter und Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften - in allen 16 Bundesländern. Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt.
Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir 3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus.
Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Werde Teil von VREY und baue mit uns das führende EnergyOS.

Why emnify

Drive new enterprise revenue across the West Coast territory, owning every stage of the sales cycle from first contact to signed contract

In your first few weeks , the priority is depth over activity. You will complete onboarding, work through product and technical training, and develop a solid grasp of emnify's ideal customer profile, buyer personas, pricing model, and competitive positioning.
By month two or three , you will be prospecting independently — running outbound alongside inbound follow-up, conducting your own discovery calls, and qualifying opportunities against emnify's framework. The broader arc is becoming a repeatable, forecastable contributor — someone with a clear territory strategy, consistent prospecting habits, strong internal relationships, and a sharp understanding of why deals are won or lost.

Everyone below that line got left with spreadsheets.
We built Precoro for the companies underneath it. A £60m business with four sites gets the control a global one has , live in about three weeks, on the finance system it already runs: Sage, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics or Xero . Who we are
Help Scout started in 2011 with a simple premise: support software should treat customers like people, not tickets. 3+ billion conversations later, more than 10,000 companies use Help Scout to grow relationships with customers of all types, from clients to patients and beyond.
Now we’re in a new chapter: not only building AI that gives teams more space to focus on the customer experience, but also reimagining how we operate in an AI-native world. That means shipping and learning faster, without compromising on craft. Great work here carries a strong opinion and sweats the details, regardless of the tools we use to drive it.
We’ve been a fully remote team since day one, with 120+ teammates now all over the world. It’s a culture where you’ll be trusted to take ownership, stay curious, and raise the quality of work around you. It comes with clear expectations and a team that will push you to do some of the best work of your career.
If that kind of challenge gives you energy, we’d love to meet you.

Today, our SMB sales motion is dialed in. The majority of new customers find us; they visit our website, start a trial, or request a walkthrough of the platform. We’ve built a process that converts these visitors into customers at an impressive rate.
Over the past year, our product has become increasingly competitive for support teams at larger companies (100-1,000 employees), but those prospects don’t always arrive on our site ready to engage. That’s where you come in.
This is a true outbound sales role, designed for a rep with world-class prospecting skills. You’ll have the opportunity to not only craft our outbound sales motion, but lead the charge competing (and winning) new upmarket customers at a higher ACV.
Please note: For this role, we are only able to hire in the United States.
In this role, you will
Build and own your pipeline. We expect more than 75% of your opportunities to be self-sourced through target account campaigns, account-based targeting, referrals, events. Inbound will support you; it won't fill your calendar.
Run full-cycle deals. You'll land the first meeting, run tailored product demos, build compelling business cases, manage commercial negotiations and seal the deal. You own the sales motion (with support from our amazing team).
Build a playbook. What works for you becomes the baseline of our upmarket sales motion. You're the first person running it, and will work with GTM leadership to set our strategy for the future.
Collaborate cross-functionally. You'll give Product direct feedback on requirements on what mid-market support teams need from us, partner with Marketing to launch targeted campaigns & and work in lockstep with RevOps to ensure our operational process is dialed in.
Own numbers . You'll own and report on pipeline coverage, forecast accuracy, and progress to target with enough rigor that leadership can plan around it.

You've sourced the majority of your own pipeline — 75% or more — and you can be specific about your strategy and results
You have 8+ years in full-cycle B2B SaaS sales, working mid-market accounts at companies of roughly 250–1,000 employees.
You're at home in a 3-6 month cycle, closing deals with with an average size of $25-$75K
You have a real point of view on account selection and engagement strategy
You are comfortable managing a modern GTM tech stack and AI solutions for prospect selection, automation, enrichment — you can build a system that works for you
You use AI daily to improve your output, and you can point to specific examples where AI changed the speed, quality, and scale of what you delivered.
You’re a problem solver, and possess a strong ability to identify customer business needs, multi-thread with key stakeholders and position relevant solutions effectively
You are comfortable being the first of something. There's no mid-market playbook here yet, and you'd rather write one than inherit one.

Company values
Happy to Help
Help is in our first name! We show up for each other — not out of obligation, but because we’re invested in the team’s collective success. We share knowledge freely, lead with generosity, and practice empathy with our teammates, customers, and community.
Craft over Convention
Our success relies on the quality and craft of the work we put into the world. The status quo simply won’t work. So we insist on narrow focus, sweating every detail, and relentless pursuit of customer delight.
Progress not Perfection
Achieving our true potential — collectively and individually — requires constant progress and forward momentum. By creating a culture of curiosity and openness, we aim to create a safe space for mistakes, the ability to identify them quickly, and use them to get better.
Own the Outcome
Own the outcome means taking full responsibility for the results of your work, decisions, and contributions. It reflects a mindset of accountability, proactiveness, and follow-through. If you “own the outcome,” you don’t just complete tasks, you ensure your work leads to meaningful results, and take initiative to solve problems rather than passing them along.

s.h: A note on the use of AI in our interview process
s.t: While we understand that AI is an important tool in a modern skillset, we ask that you do not utilize AI assistants live on our interviews. Of course, use any tools you need to prepare! But we'd like for you to have a real human-to-human conversation with our team.

Du begeisterst dich für Technologie, suchst einen Job, der unfassbar abwechslungsreich ist, du mit verschiedenen Menschen in Kontakt treten kannst und dir tiefe Einblicke in zahlreiche Unternehmen und Branchen bietet.
Deine Mission? Die Digitalsierung voranzutreiben. In dieser Position treibst du das Wachstum durch proaktive Outbound-Aktivitäten voran, generierst neue Leads und schaffst Nachfrage auf dem DACH-Markt. 🚀
Aufgaben
Wie dein Alltag aussehen wird?
Tja, gar nicht so leicht zu beantworten, denn deine Aufgaben sind abwechslungsreich und immer unterschiedlich. Aber in der Regel wirst du die Möglichkeit haben, unsere Strategie zur Lead-Generierung mitzugestalten, jeden Monat Zielbranchen auszuwählen und unsere Outreach-Aktivitäten voranzutreiben.
Lead-Generierung: Recherche und Identifikation von potenziellen Kunden über verschiedene Kanäle wie bsp. Online-Recherchen.
Nutzung verschiedener Tools und Techniken zur Kundenakquise, um eine Pipeline mit qualifizierten Leads aufzubauen.
Sales Cycle vollumfänglich managen: Du übernimmst das Cold Calling, das Versenden von E-Mails und anderen Kommunikationsmethoden, um mit potenziellen Kunden in Kontakt zu treten, um deren Geschäftsanforderungen und -prozesse zu analysieren und zu qualifizieren.
Vorbereitung und Durchführung von maßgeschneiderten Produktdemos.
Verhandlung von Verträgen und Abschlüssen mit deinen Kunden.
Du wirst zu deinen Kunden enge Beziehungen aufbauen und deren Vertrauen gewinnen.
Teilnahme an Networking-Veranstaltungen, Konferenzen und Messen, um dein Kundennetzwerk aufzubauen.
Zusammenarbeit mit dem Marketingteam, um weitere Wachstumspotenziale herauszuarbeiten.
Bitte beachte, dass diese Position in Berlin angesiedelt ist.
Qualifikation
Bei Odoo schätzen wir deine Fähigkeiten mehr als den Lebenslauf.

Erste Arbeitserfahrungen als SDR oder auf einer vergleichbaren Position im Sales sind wünschenswert.
Einen stark ausgeprägten Geschäftssinn und ein hohes Maß an Neugierde.
Resilienz & eine Get-it-Done Mentalität sowie die Fähigkeit, analytisch Probleme zu lösen.
Interesse, sich in eine Software und die SaaS-Welt einzuarbeiten.
Sehr starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.
Sprachen Deutsch & Englisch (C1-C2)
Die Fähigkeit, Vertrauen und Enthusiasmus zu schaffen.
Einen Bachelor/Master Abschluss oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
Bei Odoo setzen wir uns für ein vielfältiges, inklusives und authentisches Arbeitsumfeld ein. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen von allen Menschen, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, ethnischer Herkunft, Religion, sexueller oder Geschlechtsidentität, Behinderung oder anderen Merkmalen.Du hast Lust auf die Stelle, aber dein Profil passt nicht zu 100%? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Vielleicht bist du genau die richtige Person diesen Job!

Warum Odoo?
Langweilige 0815 Jobs, mit komplizierten Entscheidungswegen, starren Hierarchien und Micromanaging sind nicht so dein Ding? Cool, unser auch nicht!
Bei uns wirst du in einer offenen Atmosphäre arbeiten, in der du die Freiheit hast, deine Ideen zu verwirklichen. Garantiert unkompliziert! 😌
Außerdem ist unser Produkt natürlich super cool und generiert einen wirklichen Mehrwert für unsere Kund:innen
Das bietet dir Odoo
BVG-Ticket : Damit du einfach von A nach B kommst.
Sachbezug : Erhalte monatlich 50€ zum Shoppen bei zahlreichen Geschäften, Restaurants und Tankstellen.
Food & Drinks : Zentrales Office mit Spreeblick, dazu Snacks, Müsli, und Spaßgetränke, sowie einen Zuschuss zu deinem Mittagessen.
Work-Life Balance : FFlexible Arbeitszeiten bei einer 38 Stunden Woche und einem hybriden Arbeitsmodell mit 2 Homeoffice Tagen und 3 Office Tagen in unserem Büro in Friedrichshain.
Company Culture : Regelmäßige End-of-Month Events für alle sowie jedes Quartal ein Budget von 40€ pro Person für Team-Events.
Go Global - Austauschprogramm : Lust auf Auslandserfahrung? Nach 2 Jahren Odoo hast du die Möglichkeit dich an einen unserer weltweiten Standorte versetzen zu lassen.
Recruiting Prozess
01 Bewerbungsscreening
Wir checken deine Bewerbung um sicherzustellen, dass dein Profil mit den Anforderungen des Jobs matcht.
02 Videocall mit HR
In einem ersten Kennelernen sprechen wir über deine Erfahrungen, deine Motivation und die Rolle bei Odoo.
03 Technisches Interview
Jetzt wird's fachlich! Triff unsere Teamleads zu einem persönlichen Gespräch und tauche tief in die Aufgaben der Rolle ein.
04 Erhalte dein Angebot!
Wenn du alle Stufen gemeistert hast, wird es Zeit für das große Finale - ein Angebot, unserem Odoo Berlin Team beizutreten.

Be a part of our dynamic global Revenue team, reporting to the VP of Sales. You’ll be responsible for helping develop, drive, and execute an account plan to generate new business revenue, as well as year-over-year expansion and growth within your existing accounts, aligned with GWI’s growth strategy across your book of business.
Working within your dedicated market segment, you will focus on winning new customers and driving growth and expansion within your assigned book of business.
Designing a GTM strategy for your assigned prospect and customer accounts to build a pipeline that enables you to meet and exceed your quarterly and annual sales quota
Strategically mapping accounts to understand the full scope of each opportunity
Working cross-functionally with internal teams to drive additional value in active opportunities
Leading the entire sales cycle with your clients, from opportunity creation through close
Establishing and building credibility with prospects from the outset, developing a deep understanding of their business challenges, and presenting needs-based solutions that align with their objectives
Tracking all sales activity by managing opportunities and accurately forecasting revenue in Salesforce
Building strong collaboration with the CSMs assigned to your accounts to ensure customers drive value from GWI’s products and to identify and nurture additional growth and expansion opportunities
Market Insight
Stay informed about industry trends, the competitive landscape, and emerging technologies
Utilize market insights to refine sales strategies, differentiate our offerings, and maintain a competitive edge
What do I need to bring with me?
You’ll need to demonstrate the core skills required for this role. Here’s what the team will be looking for:
Extensive experience in SaaS, subscription/licensing, API-based, or consumption sales, particularly closing business within large, complex enterprise accounts
Ability to apply strategic thinking and consultative sales skills to align technology solutions with complex, multi-stakeholder business challenges
Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding sales quotas
Experience bringing innovative or market-defining products to market within a competitive landscape
Success cross-selling multiple solutions to meet client needs (subscription vs. custom offerings)
Experience following the MEDD(P)ICC sales methodology to qualify opportunities and progress deals through the pipeline
Experience in multi-threading and selling into buying committees to build consensus among key stakeholders
Experience using Salesforce to manage the sales cycle, pipeline, and forecasting
Excellent communication skills with the ability to convey complex ideas clearly and concisely
A hunter mentality, with a strong focus on outbound prospecting to build and grow your own pipeline in addition to inbound leads
Ability to engage and build relationships with C-level executives
Experience working in a startup or scale-up environment
Why GWI?
GWI is the human data layer that fuels decision-making and AI agents across the enterprise. In the age of AI, the way businesses consume insight is changing. Traditional research is no longer enough to keep up in a world of AI, automation, and agentic workflows.

Our customers need insight, not just a platform, embedded directly into the tools and workflows they use every day. GWI has been at the forefront of this shift, through the launch of Agent Spark and by empowering decision makers to move with clarity, speed, and precision, grounding every action in real human understanding.

GWI's mission remains the same: to help humans everywhere understand each other.

At GWI, you’ll find meaningful work, visible impact, and a culture that empowers you to do your best. Our package includes:
🌱 Time to recharge – 25 days’ annual leave, plus office closures over the holidays.
🌱 Health & wellbeing – Health cash plan, enhanced family benefits, carer days, and mental health support.
🌱 Financial benefits – Competitive salary, 4% pension matching, and recognition programs that celebrate success.
🌱 Flexibility & balance – Flexitime, early Friday finishes, hybrid and remote options, plus a “work from home” budget.
🌱 Career growth – Accredited learning, leadership development, and global career mobility.
🌱 Community & impact – DE&I initiatives, volunteering opportunities, donation matching, and payroll giving.
Put all that together and GWI is the friendliest, most fulfilling place any of us has ever worked.
Diversity, Equity & Inclusion 🌍
Diversity is fundamental to who we are—both as a data company and as a workplace. Our data reflects global realities, and so must our teams. We strive to ensure our workforce is as diverse and inclusive as the insights we provide to our clients.
As a Disability Confident employer, we welcome applications from disabled candidates and are committed to providing all necessary adjustments during the hiring process. We also actively encourage applications from underrepresented and marginalized communities.
At GWI, you will find a place where you can contribute meaningfully, grow professionally, and belong fully.

Remote | Unlimited Holiday | Grow customer value. Strengthen partnerships. Drive revenue.

With a robust team of over 180 professionals, we operate from offices in Tunbridge Wells and London Paddington. Our exceptional work has earned us the prestigious title of Microsoft Partner of the Year for Dynamics Business Central.

Guided by core values of empathy, creativity, ambition, authenticity, and confidence, we celebrate diversity and strive to create a supportive and innovative work environment.

This is a senior, revenue carrying role for an experienced account executive who can engage executive stakeholders, identify complex business challenges and translate those challenges into significant commercial opportunities across Microsoft technologies, managed services and consultancy engagements.
You will be responsible for building and executing strategic account plans that drive measurable customer outcomes and sustainable revenue growth for Infinity.
Success in this role requires more than strong relationships. You must be able to assess organisational priorities, uncover business change initiatives, navigate complex stakeholder groups and create momentum around opportunities that may span multiple departments, budgets and decision makers.

Own Strategic Customer Growth
Manage and grow a portfolio of strategic customer accounts.
Build account plans that drive revenue, retention and long-term customer value.
Identify white-space opportunities across Microsoft technologies and Infinity services.
Build Executive Relationships
Develop trusted relationships with senior business and technology stakeholders.
Understand customer objectives, challenges and growth plans.
Influence decision-makers and become a valued strategic advisor.
Drive Complex Opportunities
Lead opportunities from discovery through to proposal, negotiation and closure.
Work with pre-sales, consultancy and delivery teams to shape solutions.
Create business cases that connect technology investment to business outcomes.
Deliver Commercial Results
Own revenue growth, pipeline and forecasting across your account portfolio.
Drive expansion through strategic account development rather than transactional sales.
Balance customer outcomes with Infinity's commercial objectives.
Lead the Customer Internally
Act as the voice of the customer across Infinity.
Align internal teams around a clear account strategy.
Ensure opportunities, risks and customer priorities are visible and understood.
The kind of problems you’ll solve
Strategic accounts that have significant untapped growth potential but no clear account strategy.
Customers with competing priorities who need help aligning business goals with technology investment.
Accounts where key stakeholder relationships are limited and need broadening to unlock growth.
Opportunities hidden within existing customers that require discovery, business insight and executive engagement.
Customers looking to modernise, scale or transform their business but unsure where to begin.
Complex opportunities involving multiple stakeholders, departments and decision-makers.
Accounts at risk of stagnation, supplier competition or reduced customer value.
Internal teams needing clear customer insight, priorities and direction to support growth.
What sets you apart
You think strategically about accounts, not just relationships.
You build credibility with senior decision-makers and executive stakeholders.
You uncover business challenges and turn them into commercial opportunities.
You create and execute structured account growth plans.
You are comfortable leading complex, multi-stage sales opportunities.
You balance customer outcomes with commercial accountability.
You ask challenging questions and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions.
You proactively identify white-space opportunities across customers.
You influence internal and external stakeholders to drive results.
You take ownership of outcomes, not just activity.

Business Impact
Drive profitable revenue growth across strategically important customer accounts.
Increase account penetration, customer lifetime value and market share within existing customers.
Strengthen Infinity's position as a trusted Microsoft strategic partner.
Customer Impact
Help customers align technology investments with their business goals.
Deliver measurable business outcomes through strategic guidance and Microsoft solutions.
Build long-term partnerships based on trust, value and results.
Team Impact
Bring greater visibility, structure and strategic thinking to account management.
Align internal teams around clear customer priorities and growth opportunities.
Share insight, best practice and market knowledge to help elevate team performance.

Ambitious, but not political
High standards, but pragmatic
People who care about doing things properly — not just hitting numbers

Real ownership of how sales evolves
Freedom to change things that don’t work
A team open to being challenged and developed
Direct access to leadership and influence over direction

Unlimited annual leave
Private healthcare, life assurance, company shares
Electric car scheme
Flexible / remote working (with access to Tunbridge Wells & Paddington)
Team and company socials, including Illuminate Awards

Ziel der Rolle Du verwaltest keine Kontakte. Du bringst Chancen ins Rollen.
Du willst nicht einfach Kontaktlisten abarbeiten, sondern mit überzeugender Gesprächsführung, echtem Interesse und konsequentem Follow-up Geschäftschancen entwickeln? Du hast Lust auf Vertrieb mit Substanz, Verantwortung und sichtbarem Einfluss? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.
Als Inside Sales Manager (m/w/d) machst du aus Kontakten konkrete Chancen. Du übernimmst die strukturierte Bearbeitung bestehender Kontakte, Kooperationen und eingehender Leads. Du identifizierst die richtigen Entscheider:innen, verstehst ihre Herausforderungen und bringst relevante Gespräche auf den Weg.

Dabei geht es nicht um wahllose Kaltakquise oder das stumpfe Abarbeiten von Kontaktlisten. Du arbeitest mit konkreten Marktzugängen, Empfehlungen, Referenzen, Partnerkontakten und qualifizierten Anfragen – strukturiert, verbindlich und mit echtem Interesse an deinem Gegenüber. Du hörst zu, wo andere nur pitchen.

Du fragst nach, wo andere bereits verkaufen wollen. Und du bleibst dran, damit aus guten Kontakten echte Geschäftschancen werden.
Denn bei uns zählt nicht, wie oft du anrufst – sondern was du damit ins Rollen bringst.
Deine Aufgaben Du bearbeitest bestehende Kontakte, Kooperationen und eingehende Leads systematisch und eigenverantwortlich.
Du identifizierst relevante Ansprechpartner:innen und Entscheider:innen – auch in größeren und dezentral aufgebauten Organisationen.
Du stellst telefonisch und über digitale Kanäle den persönlichen Kontakt her und baust tragfähige Beziehungen auf.
Du hörst genau hin, stellst die richtigen Fragen und qualifizierst Bedarf, Anwendungsfall, Zuständigkeit, Zeitrahmen, Entscheidungsprozess und wirtschaftliches Potenzial.
Du vereinbarst qualifizierte Folgegespräche und bereitest sie so vor, dass alle Beteiligten direkt in die relevanten Themen einsteigen können.
Du begleitest ausgewählte Erst- und Folgegespräche und sorgst dafür, dass vereinbarte nächste Schritte auch tatsächlich stattfinden.
Du übergibst qualifizierte Chancen mit allen relevanten Informationen an Vertrieb, Beratung oder Geschäftsführung.
Du dokumentierst Kontakte, Gesprächsergebnisse, Potenziale und Wiedervorlagen transparent und nachvollziehbar im CRM.
Du erkennst wiederkehrende Kundenbedarfe und verdichtest einzelne Signale zu einem belastbaren Gesamtbild.
Du gestaltest unseren skalierbaren Inside-Sales-Ansatz aktiv mit und entwickelst Gesprächsleitfäden, Qualifizierungskriterien und Abläufe kontinuierlich weiter.
Bei Bedarf unterstützt du uns bei der Vorbereitung, Begleitung und Nachbereitung von Messen und Veranstaltungen.
Kurz gesagt: Du wartest nicht auf Chancen. Du entwickelst sie.
Dein Profil Was für uns zählt: Haltung, Klarheit und der Wille, etwas zu bewegen. Du bringst Erfahrung im Inside Sales, Digitalvertrieb, Sales Development, Business Development oder in der Leadqualifizierung mit.
Du setzt KI-Tools gezielt ein, erkennst neue KI-Trends frühzeitig und hast ein gutes Gespür dafür, wie sie Vertrieb und Kundenprozesse weiterentwickeln.
Du bewegst dich sicher in der digitalen Kundenansprache und weißt, wie über verschiedene Kanäle echte Vertriebschancen entstehen.
Du telefonierst gerne und trittst professionell, verbindlich und auf Augenhöhe auf.
Du kannst aktiv zuhören, gezielt nachfragen und zwischen einem netten Gespräch und einer relevanten Geschäftschance unterscheiden.
Du arbeitest strukturiert, selbstständig und konsequent – auch wenn mehrere Kontakte und nächste Schritte parallel laufen.
Du bist freundlich hartnäckig und hast ein gutes Gespür für Timing, Tonalität und den richtigen nächsten Schritt.
Du gehst sicher mit CRM-Systemen und digitalen Arbeitsmitteln um.
Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
Du interessierst dich für künstliche Intelligenz, digitale Geschäftsmodelle und die Frage, wie Technologie messbaren Mehrwert für Organisationen schafft.
Du wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand jeden Schritt vorgibt. Du übernimmst Verantwortung, bringst Ideen ein und setzt sie pragmatisch um.
Du hast Lust auf Tempo, Wachstum und ein Umfeld, in dem dein Beitrag unmittelbar sichtbar wird.
Du erfüllst nicht jeden einzelnen Punkt, erkennst dich aber in der Rolle wieder? Dann möchten wir trotzdem von dir hören. Wir suchen keine perfekte Checkliste, sondern eine Persönlichkeit, die gemeinsam mit uns etwas aufbauen und bewegen will.
Was wir bieten Gestaltungsfreiheit statt Dienst nach Vorschrift
Du übernimmst keinen fertig zementierten Prozess. Du kannst unseren Inside-Sales-Ansatz aktiv mitgestalten, Abläufe verbessern und deine Ideen direkt in die Praxis bringen.
Wirkung statt Warteschleife
Deine Arbeit verschwindet nicht in Präsentationen oder endlosen Abstimmungsrunden. Aus deinen Kontakten entstehen Gespräche, Geschäftschancen und neue Kundenbeziehungen. Dein Beitrag ist unmittelbar sichtbar.
Verantwortung ab Tag eins
Du erhältst einen eigenen Verantwortungsbereich und steuerst Prioritäten, Kontakte und Follow-ups selbstständig. Wir vertrauen darauf, dass du Entscheidungen triffst, Initiative zeigst und Themen voranbringst.
KI mit Substanz
Du verkaufst keine kurzlebige Spielerei. Du arbeitest an einem Thema, das Organisationen grundlegend verändert: dem sicheren, souveränen und skalierbaren Einsatz künstlicher Intelligenz über Daten, Prozesse und Systeme hinweg.
Lernen im Zukunftsmarkt
Du entwickelst dein Verständnis für KI-Anwendungen, digitale Geschäftsmodelle, komplexe Kundenbedarfe und moderne Vertriebsprozesse kontinuierlich weiter.
Entwicklung mit neuland.ai
Wenn neuland.ai wächst, wächst auch dein Verantwortungsbereich. Perspektivisch kannst du dich beispielsweise in Richtung Key Account Management, Business Development, Partner Management oder Sales Consulting weiterentwickeln.
Flexibilität und digitale Zusammenarbeit
Wir setzen auf eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten, digitale Prozesse und eine flexible Organisation des Arbeitsalltags im Rahmen unserer betrieblichen Möglichkeiten.
Eine Kultur, die zu unserem Namen passt
neuland bedeutet für uns: neugierig bleiben, mutig ausprobieren und Verantwortung übernehmen. Wir arbeiten offen, direkt und pragmatisch zusammen. Wir teilen Wissen, unterstützen einander und packen gemeinsam an.

Assists brokers/sellers in loan submission process.

Maintain all customer confidential information in accordance with all company policies and all laws.

Manages loan pipeline to achieve departmental goals and objectives.
Provide a high level of customer service to brokers/sellers during the loan process.

Demonstrated sales performance with a concentration developing and maintaining broker/seller relationships
Proven ability to set and reach sales goals

Knowledge of FHA, FNMA, FHLMC, VA, USDA and non-agency loan products
Knowledge of purchase transactions

Excellent verbal, written and presentation communications skills

Previous experience as a sales representative required, preferably in the mortgage industry.
